INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP_SELECT_SRC

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP_GROUP_SRC
(
                ENTITYRELATIONSHIPID,
                BANK_ID,
                PARENTAL_CONSENT_OBTAINED,
                BROKER_CIF_ID,
                ISNEWCONTACT,
                CONSENT_DATE,
                OBTAINED_FROM,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER_ALT1,
                RELATIONSHIP_ALT1,
                PARENTENTITY,
                CHILDENTITY,
                PARENTENTITYID,
                CHILDENTITYID,
                RELATIONSHIP,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                GUARD_CODE,
                BOACLID,

                PARENTCIFID,
                CHILDCIFID,
                POATYPE,
                POAFROMDATE,
                POATILLDATE,
                TMDATE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,

)

select 
                ENTITYRELATIONSHIPID,
                BANK_ID,
                PARENTAL_CONSENT_OBTAINED,
                BROKER_CIF_ID,
                ISNEWCONTACT,
                CONSENT_DATE,
                OBTAINED_FROM,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER_ALT1,
                RELATIONSHIP_ALT1,
                PARENTENTITY,
                CHILDENTITY,
                PARENTENTITYID,
                CHILDENTITYID,
                RELATIONSHIP,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                GUARD_CODE,
                BOACLID,
                EXTENSIONID,
                SECURITYILHINT,
                SECURITYIUHINT,
                SECURITYGLHINT,
                SECURITYGUHINT,
                ALLOWMODIFY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                CONTACTNAME,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER,
                RELATIONSHIP_CODE,
                CORE_CUST_ID,
                CORE_CHILD_CUST_ID,
                PARENTENTITYTYPE,
                CHILDENTITYTYPE,
                RELATIONSHIP_CATEGORY,
                [CHECKSUM],
                KNOWN_YEARS,
                ORGKEY,
                PARENTCIFID,
                CHILDCIFID,
                POATYPE,
                POAFROMDATE,
                POATILLDATE,
                TMDATE,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                ENTITYRELATIONSHIPID,
                BANK_ID,
                PARENTAL_CONSENT_OBTAINED,
                BROKER_CIF_ID,
                ISNEWCONTACT,
                CONSENT_DATE,
                OBTAINED_FROM,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER_ALT1,
                RELATIONSHIP_ALT1,
                PARENTENTITY,
                CHILDENTITY,
                PARENTENTITYID,
                CHILDENTITYID,
                RELATIONSHIP,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                GUARD_CODE,
                BOACLID,
                EXTENSIONID,
                SECURITYILHINT,
                SECURITYIUHINT,
                SECURITYGLHINT,
                SECURITYGUHINT,
                ALLOWMODIFY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                CONTACTNAME,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER,
                RELATIONSHIP_CODE,
                CORE_CUST_ID,
                CORE_CHILD_CUST_ID,
                PARENTENTITYTYPE,
                CHILDENTITYTYPE,
                RELATIONSHIP_CATEGORY,
                [CHECKSUM],
                KNOWN_YEARS,
                ORGKEY,
                PARENTCIFID,
                CHILDCIFID,
                POATYPE,
                POAFROMDATE,
                POATILLDATE,
                TMDATE,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                ENTITYRELATIONSHIPID,
                BANK_ID,
                PARENTAL_CONSENT_OBTAINED,
                BROKER_CIF_ID,
                ISNEWCONTACT,
                CONSENT_DATE,
                OBTAINED_FROM,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER_ALT1,
                RELATIONSHIP_ALT1,
                PARENTENTITY,
                CHILDENTITY,
                PARENTENTITYID,
                CHILDENTITYID,
                RELATIONSHIP,
                CONCURDETECT_X,
                GUARD_CODE,
                BOACLID,
                EXTENSIONID,
                SECURITYILHINT,
                SECURITYIUHINT,
                SECURITYGLHINT,
                SECURITYGUHINT,
                ALLOWMODIFY,
                BODATECREATED,
                BOCREATEDBY,
                BODATEMODIFIED,
                BOMODIFIEDBY,
                CONTACTNAME,
                PRIMARYINTRODUCER,
                RELATIONSHIP_CODE,
                CORE_CUST_ID,
                CORE_CHILD_CUST_ID,
                PARENTENTITYTYPE,
                CHILDENTITYTYPE,
                RELATIONSHIP_CATEGORY,
                [CHECKSUM],
                KNOWN_YEARS,
                ORGKEY,
                PARENTCIFID,
                CHILDCIFID,
                POATYPE,
                POAFROMDATE,
                POATILLDATE,
                TMDATE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ENTITYRELATIONSHIPID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ENTITYRELATIONSHIPID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

                SRC.PARENTCIFID,
                SRC.CHILDCIFID,
                SRC.POATYPE,
                SRC.POAFROMDATE,
                SRC.POATILLDATE,
                SRC.TMDATE,

				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.BANK_ID,
				'CRM',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1
